_about: Curated literature periods for the five Green Bank 20 m scans in this directory.
Transcribed from 'Curated pulsars.docx', the curation shipped alongside the scans:
period_s is its 'Period(Literature)' column, difficulty/difficulty_rank its
difficulty rating, and observation its archival observation number.
THIS DOCUMENT, NOT ATNF, IS THE REFERENCE THE TESTS COMPARE AGAINST. The atnf
block on each entry is a live-catalogue cross-check carried alongside, never the
arbiter; see test_data/README.md and tests/conftest.py for why neither value is
The scans carry no period of their own: a topocentric-period header appears only
on prefolded 'standard' files and none ship here, so the period always comes from
outside the data. That is what makes a successful fold an independent detection
rather than a fit to a known answer.
